correctness.rationale: An exact max-flow/min-cut equivalence reduces each normalized matching inequality over every subset to a saturating integer flow. The complete C++ generator independently checks Delannoy rank counts and every cover, and exhaustive exact 64-bit Dinic calculations saturate all lower-half rank pairs for n=0..18, including the n=18 product 1837659219795. An explicit unmatched-parenthesis bijection proves odd central pairs, and order-reversal plus Hall complement duality proves upper-half pairs. Full replay from the actual artifact returned VERIFY_OK 0_to_18, independently corroborated by a Python flow implementation for n=0..13. No claim extends past n=18.

value.rationale: This is a nontrivial finite bound on an explicit 2026 open normalized-matching question, extending verified normality from n<=5 to n<=18 (thirteen new sizes). The largest lattice has 6,625,109 elements and a million-plus-sized rank pair, and all exponential-family subset inequalities are resolved exactly rather than sampled. The finite result is useful evidence and a reproducible benchmark for the all-size conjecture, without asserting any general resolution.
